scope: Registered frozen corpus; active and quarantined partitions audited separately with original inputs.

examples.error: not enough values to unpack (expected 2, got 1)

retryResolution: One Python preflight exception was retained. Its unchanged input passed 20 repeat preflights, a full canonical audit, 14 process/output probes, and independent regeneration from the original capture.

repeatability.note: One saved-output comparison raised a Python TypeError. Its saved pair matched exactly on direct rechecks; all 325 confirmation checks passed. Interrupted parallel batches were preserved and rerun.

limitations: Archived template definitions are pinned; original archive master databases are not revalidated.
This is observed agreement on the frozen corpus, not universal game parity.
Unknown replay fields and hidden mechanics retain their documented coverage gaps.
Repeatability probes do not prove that nondeterminism is impossible.
Live captures collected after the frozen intake are not included.
